heroHeadline: Vera C. Rubin Observatory Begins Its Ten-Year Survey of the Universe
heroSubtitle: LSST science operations continue from Cerro Pachón, Chile — the 3,200-megapixel LSST Camera is capturing a new image roughly every 40 seconds, having logged over 11,000 new asteroids and ~380 trans-Neptunian objects, with Early Data Preview 2's COSMOS mosaic released in early August 2026 and a second EDP2 phase due Q4 2026.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
